question: Is there ANY open processed leftover of OAK/POPLAR (EGAS00001005013) that can test TACSTD2 vs atezolizumab benefit?
what_would_be_needed: Per-sample TACSTD2 (or full transcriptome) joined to treatment arm + PFS/OS in OAK and/or POPLAR, so the atezo-vs-docetaxel interaction can be recomputed.

checked.what: FASTQ, log2(TPM+1), counts, CPM, clinical for OAK n=699 and POPLAR n=192
checked.status: CONTROLLED — Genentech DAC EGAC00001002120. Not used. Out of scope for this open hunt.

checked.what: Includes POPLAR TPM matrices + clinical mixed with IMvigor210/IMmotion150

checked.source: Bessede 2024 Clin Cancer Res supplements (AACR figshare collection 10.1158/1078-0432.c.7077754)
checked.what: S1 patient characteristics (aggregated N/%); S2 multivariate HRs (TACSTD2-high PFS HR 1.31, OS HR 1.26); S3/S4 BIP protein-cohort characteristics; Fig S1/S2 captions + images
checked.status: OPEN but UNUSABLE for a re-test. No per-sample TACSTD2, no per-sample outcomes. Extracted text in data/derived/bessede_supplements_extracted.md

checked.source: Patil 2022 Cancer Cell (the paper that deposited EGAS00001005013)
checked.what: Data-availability points only at EGA + vivli. No open expression/signature matrix.
